question: Look at the financial record headings shown above. Whenever an amount of money is recorded in the "Received" column, how must you update the "Available Funds"?
options: Subtract the amount from the Available Funds.
Add the amount to the Available Funds.
Divide the Available Funds by the amount.
Leave the Available Funds unchanged.

question: Look at the financial record headings shown above. Whenever a payment is recorded in the "Expenses" column, how must you update the "Available Funds"?
options: Subtract the amount from the Available Funds.
Add the amount to the Available Funds.
Multiply the Available Funds by the amount.
Double the previous Available Funds.

question: When is a personal budget described as "balanced"?
options: When Total Expenses are higher than Total Income.
When Total Income is always more than $200.
When Total Income equals Total Expenses.
When every expense costs the exact same amount.

question: Look at the monthly budget summary shown above. Which statement accurately describes this budget?
options: The budget is balanced because both totals are above $150.
The budget has $35 of spare money left over to spend.
The budget is not balanced because Expenses are $35 more than Income.
The budget can be balanced by spending an extra $35.
